testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the center point context menu ✔ Given an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the Center Point row ✔ Then the Center Point row is highlighted ✔ And its context menu offers Copy, Measure, Create Note and Visibility ✔ And the menu offers Relationships ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the context menu closes ✔ And the block remains visible in the same apparent view
